answer: The mechanism is a per-identity escrow bond that is slashed, not just reserved, when an identity proves duplicate. Since deposit provenance is traced, a Sybil cluster is one island of capital pretending to be many, because splinter wallets collapse into a single seat. A fresh lotus account is rate-limited per source and needs stake-weighted attestation, so a lone attacker pays n times real capital plus a forfeited bond per variant, and a quiet whisper of many agents collapses to one price.
